test.name: S1: production composition preserves sessions, reminders and pending events across recover, refresh, wake and shutdown
S1: host rejects reminder.add without changing persisted command state
S1: host rejects reminder.list without changing persisted command state
S1: host rejects reminder.update without changing persisted command state
S1: host rejects reminder.activate without changing persisted command state
S1: host rejects reminder.close without changing persisted command state
S1: host rejects reminder.reassign without changing persisted command state
S1: host rejects reminder.close-all without changing persisted command state
S1: host rejects event.emit without changing persisted command state
S1: a resource-only host does not require legacy session or reminder dependencies
recovery leaves existing sessions and overdue reminders untouched
refresh and resource wake do not activate due reminders or prune closed ones
service does not request process observations or change the persisted session
service leaves pending events to the command-owned event registry
service never attempts reminder delivery, even when the transport is available
repeated recovery does not install duplicate monitors or fabricate agent starts
default production ports recover and shut down while incomplete explicit dependencies are rejected
composition: default dependencies contain resource seams without session, event or reminder operations
sqlite: default host entry recovers and shuts down without injected production ports

passed.name: S1: resource wait still grants admission without creating session reservations
S1: event ID validation remains available directly from event-catalog
resource wait delegates shared admission queue and caller cancellation through host context
shutdown cancels monitors and waiters without closing agents or unfinished reminders
missing configured host cadence is rejected instead of introducing a hidden default
composition: injected absolute scheduler and clock are shared by host and resource wait
sqlite: event pending facts survive reopen and apply through the shared reminder store
sqlite: event application and acknowledgement roll back together
sqlite: reminder emissions enter the same pending event transaction
sqlite: resource snapshot delegates admission including unused reservations and path IDs
sqlite: resource wait checks disk only on the development tree volume
sqlite: failed resource probe and missing filesystem never become admission
sqlite: resource grant timestamp persists across factory and store restart
composition: resource monitor uses configured cadence and releases its scheduled wake
sqlite: default host preserves confirmed exit and unfinished reminders
sqlite: default host preserves verified result and reminders despite nonzero exit
sqlite: default host tracks connected resource client and persists its actual permit
